question: Which permanent QQBot inbound WebSocket ceiling should OpenClaw support: the 1 MiB value enforced by this branch or the 16 MiB value described and exercised in the submitted proof?
rationale: The `ws` dependency supports either value, but it cannot establish which QQBot dispatch size preserves existing delivery behavior while providing an appropriate memory bound.

options.title: Adopt and prove 16 MiB
options.body: Update the branch and tests to 16 MiB, retain the demonstrated headroom above 1 MiB, and post proof captured from that exact head.

options.title: Retain 1 MiB with QQ contract evidence
options.body: Keep 1 MiB only if the QQBot owner can cite and test a supported inbound-event bound that demonstrates legitimate dispatches cannot exceed it.

options.title: Pause this hardening change
options.body: Defer the limit until a QQBot owner can establish an event-size contract rather than selecting a potentially delivery-breaking threshold.

recommendation.title: Adopt and prove 16 MiB
recommendation.body: Update the branch and tests to 16 MiB, retain the demonstrated headroom above 1 MiB, and post proof captured from that exact head.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent QQBot extension work makes this the strongest available routing signal for a channel-specific delivery and transport-limit decision.
